implementation_plan.description: Create the root index.html file with a proper HTML5 boilerplate: DOCTYPE declaration, <html lang='en'>, <head> with meta charset, viewport meta tag, a descriptive <title>, and the opening <body> tag. Set a data-theme attribute on <html> defaulting to 'light' so CSS custom-property theming works without JavaScript at first paint.

Embed a full CSS reset inside a <style> block in <head>. Use a modern minimal reset (box-sizing: border-box on *, margin/padding zeroing, font-size normalisation, line-height inherit) rather than the heavy normalize.css so the file stays lean. Reset lists (ul/ol), buttons, inputs, and anchors individually to wipe browser defaults that would conflict with the custom design.

Define CSS custom properties (variables) on the :root selector for the light theme and override them under [data-theme='dark']. Variables must cover: --color-bg, --color-surface, --color-surface-alt, --color-border, --color-text-primary, --color-text-secondary, --color-accent, --color-accent-hover, --color-danger, --color-shadow, --color-toggle-bg, --color-toggle-icon. Also define non-colour tokens: --spacing-xs through --spacing-xl, --radius-sm, --radius-md, --radius-lg, --radius-full, --font-family, --font-size-base, --font-size-sm, --font-size-lg, --font-size-xl, --font-size-xxl, --transition-speed.

Write global / body styles: apply var(--font-family) using a system font stack ('Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif) so zero external requests are needed. Set background-color to var(--color-bg), color to var(--color-text-primary), min-height: 100vh, and a smooth CSS transition on background-color and color so theme switching is animated. Centre the page content with a max-width container using flexbox column layout.

Build the <header> element. It contains: an <h1> with the app title 'My Todos', and a <button id='theme-toggle'> that displays a sun/moon icon via inline SVG (no img src = no external request). The header uses flexbox with space-between alignment. Style the h1 with var(--font-size-xxl), font-weight 700, and the accent colour. Style the toggle button as a circular icon button with a smooth icon swap handled by CSS (show .icon-sun vs .icon-moon based on [data-theme] attribute selector).

Build the todo-input section inside <main>. Use a <section class='input-area'> containing a <form id='todo-form'>: a text <input id='todo-input' type='text' placeholder='What needs to be done?'> and a <button type='submit' id='add-btn'>Add</button>. Style the form as a flex row. The input takes flex: 1 with var(--radius-md) border-radius, var(--color-border) border, padding from spacing tokens, and focus ring using the accent colour. The add button gets the accent background, white text, border-radius, and a hover state.

Build the todo list container. Place a <section class='todo-section'> after the input area containing an empty <ul id='todo-list'> with a placeholder <li class='empty-state'> (text: 'No todos yet — add one above!'). Style the <ul> with no list-style, the surface background var(--color-surface), box-shadow using var(--color-shadow), and border-radius var(--radius-lg). Each future <li> will inherit card-like styles. The empty-state li should be centred, italic, and styled with var(--color-text-secondary).

with three . Style the footer as a responsive flexbox row. Filter buttons get a subtle active state (border + accent colour). The clear-completed button gets the danger colour. Use aria-pressed on the filter buttons for accessibility.

Add a minimal <script> block at the bottom of <body> (before </body>) for theme toggle only. The script reads localStorage for saved theme preference, applies it on load (preventing flash of wrong theme by setting the attribute before DOMContentLoaded completes — achieved by placing a tiny inline script in <head>), and wires up the toggle button click handler to flip data-theme between 'light' and 'dark' and persist to localStorage. No other JS is included in this step — todo logic is a future task.

Add polishing CSS: smooth hover/focus transitions on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs), a subtle app-level background pattern or gradient on the page background, responsive breakpoints (mobile-first, single breakpoint at 600px), print styles that hide the header theme toggle and footer controls, and a :focus-visible ring that uses the accent colour to support keyboard navigation without showing rings on mouse clicks.

Validate, review, and commit. Run the file through the W3C HTML validator mentally (confirm no deprecated tags, all ARIA roles present, all form elements have accessible labels/placeholders). Verify the file has zero external HTTP references by grepping for 'http' outside of comments. Commit with a descriptive message.

new_files.purpose: The single, self-contained application shell for the Todo App. Provides the complete semantic HTML5 document structure, all embedded CSS (reset, custom properties, theming, layout, component styles, responsive breakpoints), and a minimal inline script for light/dark theme persistence. Acts as the foundation that all subsequent feature branches will build upon — adding interactive JavaScript for CRUD operations, drag-and-drop, persistence, etc.

head: <!DOCTYPE html> + <html lang='en' data-theme='light'>
<meta charset='UTF-8'>
<meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0'>
<title>My Todos</title>
Inline <script> — reads localStorage theme preference and sets data-theme BEFORE render to avoid FOUC
<style> block containing all CSS
body: <header> — h1 title + theme toggle button (inline SVG icon)

test_plan: VISUAL: Open index.html in Chrome and Firefox — verify the page renders without any console errors, network requests, or missing resources
VISUAL: Confirm page layout: header at top with title and toggle button, input form below, empty todo list container, footer with 3 filter buttons and clear button
THEME-TOGGLE: Click the theme toggle button — verify the entire page smoothly transitions from light theme to dark theme (background, text, input, footer all change)
THEME-TOGGLE: Reload the page after toggling to dark — verify dark theme persists (localStorage key 'theme' = 'dark' was saved and re-applied on load without flash of light theme)
THEME-TOGGLE: Toggle back to light — verify all CSS custom property colours revert correctly with no leftover dark-mode artefacts
NO-EXTERNAL-DEPS: Open DevTools Network tab, hard-reload the page — verify zero external HTTP requests (no fonts, no scripts, no stylesheets, no images loaded from network)
ACCESSIBILITY: Tab through all interactive elements — verify visible :focus-visible ring appears on the input, add button, filter buttons, clear button, and theme toggle; confirm logical tab order
ACCESSIBILITY: Use a screen reader (or axe DevTools) — verify h1 has correct heading level, filter nav has aria-label, filter buttons have aria-pressed, form input has accessible label/placeholder
HTML-VALIDITY: Paste index.html into https://validator.w3.org/#validate_by_input — verify zero errors and zero warnings
CSS-VALIDITY: Paste the <style> block into the W3C CSS validator — verify zero errors
RESPONSIVE: Resize viewport to 375px width (mobile) — verify no horizontal scrollbar, input area stacks or shrinks correctly, footer wraps gracefully
RESPONSIVE: Resize to 768px and 1200px — verify centred container with appropriate max-width is respected

SEMANTIC-STRUCTURE: In DevTools Elements panel, confirm: one <header>, one <main>, one <footer>, <ul id='todo-list'> exists, <form id='todo-form'> exists, all interactive elements are actual <button> elements (not divs)
CSS-RESET: Inspect browser default styles are overridden — no bullet points on <ul>, no default margins on <h1>, no default button appearance on filter buttons
CUSTOM-PROPERTIES: In DevTools, inspect :root computed styles — confirm all --color-* and --spacing-* variables are listed with correct values
EMPTY-STATE: Verify the empty-state <li> is visible and styled with secondary colour and italic text when the list is empty
rollback_plan:
Because this feature introduces only a single new file (index.html) on the isolated feature branch 'feature/base-html-css-foundation', rollback is straightforward and non-destructive to any other work:

1. SOFT ROLLBACK (revert file to previous state):
   git checkout HEAD~1 -- index.html
   (If the file did not exist before, this will remove it)

2. FULL BRANCH ROLLBACK (discard all commits on the branch):
   git reset --hard origin/main
   (Resets the feature branch pointer back to main, removing all feature commits)

3. BRANCH DELETION (if the branch should be abandoned):
   git checkout main
   git branch -D feature/base-html-css-foundation
   git push origin --delete feature/base-html-css-foundation

4. PR/MERGE ROLLBACK (if already merged to main):
   git revert <merge-commit-hash> -m 1
   git push origin main
   (Creates a new revert commit rather than rewriting history — safe for shared branches)

No database migrations, dependency changes, or configuration file alterations are made by this feature, so rollback has zero risk of breaking other systems.
